description: Namur - Voiries avec homonyme(s) sur plusieurs localités is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Liste des voiries officielles qui s'étendent sur plusieurs localités et donc plusieurs codes rues. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Urban planning, Heritage. Its keywords are Voirie, Homonyme. The portal shows 233 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
